import torch

torch.manual_seed(42)
x = torch.tensor([[-1.0], [0.0], [1.0]])
y = torch.tensor([[-1.0], [1.0], [3.0]])
model = torch.nn.Linear(1, 1)
loss_fn = torch.nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1)
model.train()
for epoch in range(120):
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    prediction = model(x)
    loss = loss_fn(prediction, y)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    print("预测", model(x).ravel().tolist())
    print("最终损失", loss_fn(model(x), y).item())

import torch

model = torch.nn.Linear(1, 1)
model.eval()
print("eval 仍记录求导", model(torch.ones(1, 1)).requires_grad)
with torch.no_grad():
    print("no_grad 下", model(torch.ones(1, 1)).requires_grad)

import torch

torch.manual_seed(42)
x = torch.tensor([[-1.0], [0.0], [1.0]])
y = torch.tensor([[-5.0], [-2.0], [1.0]])
model = torch.nn.Linear(1, 1)
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1)
loss_fn = torch.nn.MSELoss()
for _ in range(120):
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = loss_fn(model(x), y)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
print("权重", model.weight.detach().item())
print("偏置", model.bias.detach().item())
assert abs(model.weight.detach().item() - 3) < 1e-4
assert abs(model.bias.detach().item() + 2) < 1e-4

from examples.torch_core import autograd_demo

result = autograd_demo()
assert result["prediction"] == 5.5
assert result["loss"] == 2.25
assert result["gradients"]["b2"] == 3.0
print(result)
